foundation.purpose: Stable primitives, artifact transport/identity, normalized state, graph and semantic representation.

understanding.purpose: Minecraft meaning, authored intent, behavior, target/runtime compatibility and evidence-backed knowledge.

diagnosis.purpose: Defect contracts, hypothesis reasoning, constraint solving and minimum-sufficient analysis planning.

repair.purpose: Controlled mutation and preservation of behavior outside the intended change.

validation-reliability.purpose: Validation, runtime evidence, controlled experiments, regression intelligence and reliability search.

orchestration.purpose: Repository task routing, cross-owner composition and canonical bug-report handoff.
